purpose: Provide one owner-local deterministic execution surface for PROFILE_RUNTIME_V3 checks so PASE orchestration can invoke Runtime without embedding Runtime work in Validate Packs.

input_contract.runtime_test_dependencies: services/profile_runtime_api/requirements-dev.in must be installed by the execution environment before normal run

ownership_invariants: PROFILE_RUNTIME_V3 may consume the transversal gate-group engine but does not become the owner of GATE_CHECK_OBSERVABILITY.
The runner must not execute Claim or deep Excel qualification steps owned by GATE_CHECK_OBSERVABILITY.
The runner must not resolve whether PROFILE_RUNTIME_V3 applies; it receives that decision from PASE governance.
The runner must not execute PACK_VALIDATION, S30, DB regression, Assurance, Contract Check or transversal README controls.
The historical Validate LF Packs workflow is not an ownership authority for Profile Runtime.
Normal execution stops on the first owner-check failure and returns no merge/deploy/production authorization.
